Full marks may be obtained for answers to ALL questions. Mathematical formulae booklets published by the Board are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving the answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. Start each question on a fresh page.

questions.enonce_markdown:
The table below shows some particular values of two variables $x$ and $y$.

| $x$ | 2 | 13 | 24 | 37 | 52 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $y$ | 3.1 | 5.4 | 6.5 | 7.6 | 8.2 |

It is known that $x$ and $y$ satisfy a relation of the form $y = ax^n$. By drawing a suitable linear graph relating $\log y$ and $\log x$, find the values of the constants $a$ and $n$, giving the answer to one decimal place. (8 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Reduction to linear form.** Take logarithms (base $10$) of $y = ax^n$:

$$\log y = n\log x + \log a.$$

This is a straight line $Y = nX + c$ with $Y = \log y$, $X = \log x$, **gradient** $n$ and **vertical intercept** $c = \log a$. So we plot $\log y$ (vertical axis) against $\log x$ (horizontal axis).

**Table of values** (to 3 decimal places):

| $x$ | 2 | 13 | 24 | 37 | 52 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $X = \log x$ | 0.301 | 1.114 | 1.380 | 1.568 | 1.716 |
| $y$ | 3.1 | 5.4 | 6.5 | 7.6 | 8.2 |
| $Y = \log y$ | 0.491 | 0.732 | 0.813 | 0.881 | 0.914 |

**The graph.** Take the horizontal axis for $\log x$ from $0$ to $2$ (for example $4\ \mathrm{cm}$ per $0.5$ units) and the vertical axis for $\log y$ from $0$ to $1$ (for example $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ per $0.2$ units). Plot the five points $(0.301, 0.491)$, $(1.114, 0.732)$, $(1.380, 0.813)$, $(1.568, 0.881)$, $(1.716, 0.914)$. They lie close to a straight line (a rising line that flattens slightly), so the relation $y = ax^n$ is acceptable. Draw the line of best fit through the points, with the points balanced on either side of it.

**Reading the graph.** The line of best fit passes through the points $(0.30,\ 0.49)$ and $(1.70,\ 0.91)$.

Gradient:

$$n = \frac{0.91 - 0.49}{1.70 - 0.30} = \frac{0.42}{1.40} = 0.30.$$

Intercept on the vertical axis (at $X = 0$): $c = 0.49 - 0.30 \times 0.30 = 0.40$, so

$$\log a = 0.40 \quad\Longrightarrow\quad a = 10^{0.40} = 2.51 \approx 2.5.$$

**Check by calculation** (least-squares line through the five points): gradient $0.3017$ and intercept $0.3994$, i.e. $n = 0.30$ and $a = 10^{0.3994} = 2.51$. The line through the first and last points gives $n = 0.2986$ and $a = 2.52$. All give the same values to one decimal place. A further check of the model $y = 2.5x^{0.3}$: at $x = 2$ it gives $3.08$ (data $3.1$), at $x = 24$ it gives $6.49$ (data $6.5$), at $x = 52$ it gives $8.18$ (data $8.2$).

$$\boxed{a \approx 2.5,\quad n \approx 0.3,\qquad\text{so}\quad y \approx 2.5\,x^{0.3}}$$
